summary: Verified the fix for the previously reported Admin > Database > Export crash on web preview. Confirmed via code review that Platform.OS==='web' guards were added at the top of both handleExport and handleImport in admin.tsx, using the new admin.webUnsupported translation key. Live browser testing on the web preview confirms both Export and Import buttons now show the graceful toast 'This feature requires Expo Go or an installed app on your phone' with NO raw JS error ('this.validatePath is not a function') and no crash. Quick regression check of Admin tab (Season period pickers, Database section, presence of Banner/Language sections in DOM) shows no breakage; no React Native red screen error encountered.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx: handleExport and handleImport both correctly short-circuit with Platform.OS==='web' check before any expo-file-system code executes, mirroring the existing pattern in dragon-weight.tsx handleExportPdf. This eliminates the previously reported crash.
Translation key admin.webUnsupported present in both English and Danish locales in i18n/translations.ts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from iteration_25/26 (admin export 'this.validatePath is not a function' crash on web) is now fully fixed and verified via live browser test. Both Export and Import buttons on Admin > Database show graceful toast on web preview. Real native Share/file-picker behavior remains untestable in web preview by design (same limitation noted for the Weight PDF feature) - not a blocker.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration is a fix verification, not a new bug report. Original RCA (from iteration_26) was: expo-file-system's File/Paths API is unsupported on web, causing new File(Paths.document, ...) to produce an object missing validatePath(). Fix: added Platform.OS==='web' guard before any expo-file-system code runs in both handleExport and handleImport.
